profile.headline: Senior Software Developer  (HPCC/ECL)  at LexisNexis Risk (HealthCare)
profile.summary:
Over 26 years of Experience in the Software/OS Systems/Applications/Database Management Systems in the Education ,Telecom and REO Properties area. 

Interested in projects that Integrate Applications and Database Management and Information Systems (Unix,Postgres, Oracle, Sybase, MSSQL) , UNIX, ETL  skills used to manipulate data from different sources into database schemas adhering to a database design and model.

Experience with reporting (BI) and alerting (Monitoring) applications.
Updating and Cleansing of the DB (deletion) of OLTP. 
Advanced SQL query planning and execution.

M.S. Computer Science (Stevens Tech)
B.S. Computer Science (Newark College of Engineering / NJIT)

Projects and Experiences: UNIX  (Solaris , Linux ,Red Hat ) Admin, Shell (Bash, csh, ksh) , Perl , C , Postgres PL/PGSQL, PGAdmin , C++ / OOD , DBMS Admin (Postgres, Oracle ,Ingres (C/QUEL) , MSSQL 2k) ,VPN connections (Snapgear, Cisco) , Network & TCP/IP Support, , Install/Config/Support of systems hosting Vrtual Conferencing using (VMWARE Host ESX/ RedHat deployment)

positions.title: Member of Data Services Group
positions.description: Manage REO Property Listings data, provide alerts and reports summarizing business activities , trends and finances supporting upper management and project manager decisions.  Unix/Linux , Shell / PSQL/PGSQL Procedures , Python, Postgres RDMS functions, DBA skills (2008-2010) , Volume Management Disk Array / IBM Blade servers Administration and Remote Management (Suse Linux), Eclipse Environment /Java software applications.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
Migration Projects- Data Center TCP/IP,Domain server/apps re-arrangements & Trouble-shooting Network & Application problems for Org. members providing Education or Support. Business Continuity Plan (BCP) & Implementation over WAN.

Primary contact on behalf of Education & Training Organization for issues with Network/ TCP/IP , Proxy/DNS/Gateway/Mailhost, Server Security . OS and Apps Integration Install & Support for ~25 Servers composing Prod/Dev : Solaris, Oracle, Linux, Red Hat, MSSQL 2000, Cold Fusion Server , Apache, IIS, Windows 2000/2003 Server, Interwise VoIP , HATSIZE Virtual Labs -VMWARE ESX , VPN with Snapgear all-in-one router to support remote NE/shows , Some HiD/ ERX1400 and Cisco , build secured ftp (Jailkit) server (Linux Virtual Appliance ). 

(Telcordia/Bellcore NJ) EPLANS Software Developer with Bell Labs Telecom Engineers -algorithms for RBOC network planners (Siemens FL). -TMN Network Element (NE) Mgt System "Worldwin" . Principal in the OS/ Systems ,On-site & in-house install/deploy, Sizing Sun hardware according to customer Network,Protocols, DBMS ,Solaris, Veritas VM, Sybase, Arbor BP,Sunlink X.25

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff - Software Developer
positions.description: Bellcore (Bell Communications Research) -  Member of MATFAP/Siml programing group.  Developing Algorithms for Long Range Metropolitan Area Network Planners to use  in Regional Telephone Companies (RBOCS) to evolve the network according to forecasted 20 year demand.   Heavy use of Ingres DBMS and interfaces to FEPS and TIRKS Telecom databases.   C/QUEL  (Embedded QUEL in C) use extensively.   In 1992 , the algorithms and interfaces were re-written and re-designed for C++ and XWindows GUI.

positions.title: Western Electric / AT&T Bell Labs
positions.description: Fortran - Simulation Algorithms development for Fundamental Network Planning systems - Member of EPLANS at Western Electric (Newark NJ) and Software Development Group/Engineers for Bell Labs (Long Branch NJ).
